galloway_visitor_ranger.text: Welcome to Glen Trool. Maps are free. Midges are free too, I am afraid.
Red kites were brought back to Galloway from 2001. Look up on a bright day for the forked tail.
Galloway Forest Park is the biggest in Britain, and in 2009 it became the UK's first Dark Sky Park. On a clear night, the stars come out in thousands.

galloway_visitor_volunteer.text: At dusk, a Pinewraith hunts in the treetops. They are shy, so stand still and wait. The stags in autumn are anything but shy.
